basic_info.description: - 772-774 14th Street presents a rare chance to own a classic San Francisco Victorian in an unbeatable location just off Market Street, surrounded by shops, cafes, nightlife, gyms, and easy access to MUNI and tech corridors. This four-unit building offers remarkable potential for restoration or redevelopment. The Upper level consists of two beautifully maintained units, featuring elegant period details, abundant natural light, and thoughtful updates throughout. The Lower level, composed of two units currently combined, offers soaring ceilings and original character ready for a full renovation and creative redesign. There are 2 tandem parking spaces, 1 rented, and a spacious garage. With strong architectural bones and flexible configuration options, this property is ideal for experienced developers ready to reimagine its next chapter. A true contractor's special, it's a chance to revitalize a grand historic building in one of San Francisco's most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods.
